**How to get back to it**
A seed is usually the shortest route: the game-over screen prints one, and
`window.__slowblue.restart(<seed>)` in the console replays that run. Say which act and
station, if you know.

**Device and browser**
e.g. iPhone 13, iOS 18 Safari / Pixel 7, Chrome 131 / desktop Firefox 133

**Installed or in a tab**
"Add to Home Screen" and a browser tab are not always the same thing, so it helps to know.
